description: Remove a remote post's registration and Antiphony's copy of its audio. The record in its own repo is untouched.

main.description: Removes the calling tenant's registration and Antiphony's copy: the index entry, the transcript, and the audio and its variants unless another post still uses them. A content-free ledger entry is kept, so a later getRemotePost is RemotePostDeleted. Idempotent: `deleted` is false when there was no registration. For a pushed space record no recheck has read, this is the only way Antiphony learns the record is gone, so send it when the member deletes the record. Tenant-level: a service token is enough, no acting actor.

deleted.description: Whether a registration was removed. False when there was none to remove.
